emailDomains.title: Work email domains
emailDomains.description: Domains matched by the pro_email rule (e.g. example.com). Overrides the local value.

fail_mode.title: Behavior when a site adapter breaks
fail_mode.description: What happens when content cannot be scanned (site adapter broken, text over the scan limit, file too large or unreadable, scan error). open = send, warn = send with a visible warning, closed = block.

rules.title: Detection rules
rules.description: One entry per rule type. A managed entry overrides the local rule of the same type; other types stay user-configurable.

allowlist.title: Allowlist
allowlist.description: Exact values that never trigger a rule (test keys, public addresses). Added to the user's own allowlist.

lock_settings.title: Lock local settings
lock_settings.description: true = the user's own settings are ignored: rules not listed here use the extension defaults, and only the managed allowlist applies. false or absent = unlisted rules and the local allowlist stay user-configurable.
